blocks.zh: 設計要求與風險分析 — 23 項 NIS 設計規定詳解
blocks.en: Design Requirements and Risk Analysis: The 23 NIS Design Requirements Explained

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 14971 風險分析如何整合進 ISO 11608-1 設計要求（5.3 的強制性規定）
blocks.en: Understand how ISO 14971 risk analysis is integrated into the ISO 11608-1 design requirements (the mandatory provisions of 5.3)

blocks.zh: 掌握 5.5 節 23 項設計要求的核心，辨別哪些與 CDMO 充填製程直接相關
blocks.en: Master the core of the 23 design requirements in Section 5.5 and identify which ones relate directly to CDMO filling processes

blocks.zh: 了解量測不確定度（Measurement Uncertainty）要求對 CDMO QC 測試設備的影響
blocks.en: Understand how the measurement uncertainty requirement affects CDMO QC test equipment

blocks.zh: 能在審查客戶 Design Verification 報告時，識別關鍵設計要求是否已被驗證
blocks.en: When reviewing a customer's Design Verification report, be able to tell whether the key design requirements have been verified

blocks.en: Sections 5.3–5.4: Risk Analysis Requirements and Measurement Uncertainty

blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 量測不確定度：影響 CDMO 合規判定
blocks.en: Measurement Uncertainty: Its Effect on CDMO Compliance Decisions

blocks.zh: ISO 14253-1 的「符合性判定規則」在實務上意味著：
blocks.en: In practice, the "decision rules for proving conformity" of ISO 14253-1 mean:

blocks.zh: 保守判定：如果測量值 ± 不確定度跨越規格限，就不能宣告合格，需要更精確的測試或更保守的規格
blocks.en: Conservative decisions: if the measured value ± the uncertainty crosses the specification limit, conformity cannot be declared, and either a more accurate test or a more conservative specification is needed

blocks.zh: 這直接影響 CDMO 在充填製程驗證中設定 Internal Acceptance Criteria（內部接受標準）的方式
blocks.en: This directly affects how a CDMO sets its Internal Acceptance Criteria in filling process validation

blocks.zh: 通常 CDMO 的 IAC 會比客戶 Release Criteria 更嚴格，以留下量測不確定度的緩衝
blocks.en: A CDMO's IAC is usually tighter than the customer's Release Criteria, to leave a buffer for measurement uncertainty

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：測量不確定度的符合性影響
blocks.en: Analogy: How Measurement Uncertainty Affects Conformity

blocks.zh: 體重計顯示 99.5 kg，規格上限是 100 kg。如果體重計的量測不確定度是 ±1 kg，真實值可能在 98.5–100.5 kg 之間。
blocks.en: A scale reads 99.5 kg and the specification upper limit is 100 kg. If the scale's measurement uncertainty is ±1 kg, the true value may lie anywhere between 98.5 and 100.5 kg.

blocks.zh: ISO 14253-1 的保守判定會說：不能宣告合格，因為不確定度範圍超過了規格限。
blocks.en: The conservative decision rule of ISO 14253-1 says: conformity cannot be declared, because the uncertainty range extends beyond the specification limit.

blocks.zh: 在 NIS 劑量準確性測試中，這意味著 k<sub>act</sub> 必須明顯大於 k<sub>tar</sub>，而非剛好等於。
blocks.en: In NIS dose accuracy testing, this means k<sub>act</sub> must be clearly greater than k<sub>tar</sub>, not merely equal to it.

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 + IEC 62366：雙軌風險管理
blocks.en: ISO 14971 + IEC 62366: Dual-Track Risk Management

blocks.zh: Section 5.3 要求兩個平行但互補的風險工具：
blocks.en: Section 5.3 requires two parallel but complementary risk tools:

blocks.zh: 例如：自動注射器的「針頭未完全縮回」是 ISO 14971 的風險（傷害患者）；「使用者不知道藥已打完」是 IEC 62366 的可用性問題（劑量不足）。兩者在設計驗證中都需要被驗證。
blocks.en: For example, an autoinjector's "needle not fully retracted" is an ISO 14971 risk (harm to the patient), while "the user does not know the dose has been completely delivered" is an IEC 62366 usability issue (underdosing). Both must be verified in design verification.

blocks.zh: Section 5.5: General Design Requirements — 23 項設計規定
blocks.en: Section 5.5: General Design Requirements: The 23 Design Provisions

blocks.zh: CDMO 最需關注的要求：u 和 v
blocks.en: The Requirements CDMOs Should Watch Most: u and v

blocks.zh: 要求 u — 藥品與裝置接觸的不良影響：
blocks.en: Requirement u: Adverse effects of the drug on the device and of the device on the drug:

blocks.zh: 這是 Extractables & Leachables（E&L）研究的法規依據
blocks.en: This is the regulatory basis for Extractables & Leachables (E&L) studies

blocks.zh: CDMO 的藥品直接接觸 PFS 的矽化塗層、橡膠活塞、不鏽鋼針頭
blocks.en: The CDMO's drug product is in direct contact with the PFS's silicone coating, rubber plunger and stainless steel needle

blocks.zh: 客戶的 Risk Assessment 應覆蓋所有接觸面，並符合 ISO 10993-1（要求 v）
blocks.en: The customer's Risk Assessment should cover all contact surfaces and comply with ISO 10993-1 (requirement v)

blocks.zh: CDMO 在技術轉移時需確認：客戶是否已完成 E&L 研究，且研究涵蓋 CDMO 使用的相同供應商/批號的初級包材
blocks.en: During technology transfer, the CDMO needs to confirm that the customer has completed the E&L study and that it covers primary packaging components from the same suppliers/lots as those the CDMO uses

blocks.zh: 要求 w：CDMO 有機會發揮的空間
blocks.en: Requirement w: Where the CDMO Can Add Value

blocks.zh: 要求 w 說：「沒有接受標準的測試，製造商自行建立規格。」
blocks.en: Requirement w says: "for tests without acceptance criteria, the manufacturer establishes its own specifications."

blocks.zh: 這意味著某些測試（如自由跌落測試的外觀檢查標準）由客戶根據風險分析自定。
blocks.en: This means that certain tests (such as the visual inspection criteria for the free fall test) are defined by the customer based on the risk analysis.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言：技術轉移 protocol 必須清楚定義哪些測試的 Acceptance Criteria 由客戶提供，哪些是 ISO 強制規定的。若客戶 AC 過於寬鬆，CDMO 有責任提出風險評估質疑。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: the technology transfer protocol must clearly define which tests have Acceptance Criteria supplied by the customer and which are mandated by ISO. If the customer's AC is too lenient, the CDMO has a responsibility to challenge it with a risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明：狀態指示要求（e-h）的設計哲學
blocks.en: Analogy: The Design Philosophy of the Status Indication Requirements (e-h)

blocks.zh: 要求 e-h 本質上是「操作反饋設計」：使用者在每個步驟都需要確認：
blocks.en: Requirements e-h are essentially "operational feedback design": the user needs confirmation at every step:

blocks.zh: e：設定了（我選了 1 mL，按鍵有聲音）
blocks.en: e: It is set (I selected 1 mL, and the dial makes a sound)

blocks.zh: f：準備好了（蓋子已移除，準備注射）
blocks.en: f: It is ready (the cap has been removed and the device is ready to inject)

blocks.zh: g：狀態改變了（注射前後外觀不同，避免重複注射）
blocks.en: g: The state has changed (the device looks different before and after injection, to prevent repeat injection)

blocks.zh: h：打完了（聽到「咔」或感覺到設備縮回）
blocks.en: h: It is finished (you hear a "click" or feel the device retract)

blocks.zh: 這些要求正是 IEC 62366 可用性工程的精髓：「任何步驟的操作失誤都不能導致危害」。
blocks.en: These requirements are the essence of IEC 62366 usability engineering: "an operating error at any step must not lead to harm".

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 客戶的 autoinjector（D1 系統）沒有剩餘藥量視窗，只有「已打完」指示燈。哪個設計要求（a-w）可能受到挑戰？應如何進行風險評估？
blocks.en: A customer's autoinjector (D1 system) has no residual drug volume window, only a "dose complete" indicator light. Which design requirement (a-w) might be challenged, and how should the risk assessment be carried out?

blocks.zh: CDMO 發現客戶的 E&L 研究使用的是不同供應商的矽化 PFS，而 CDMO 採購的 PFS 來自另一家供應商。依據要求 u，CDMO 應如何處理？
blocks.en: The CDMO finds that the customer's E&L study used a PFS from a different siliconization supplier than the PFS the CDMO purchases. Under requirement u, how should the CDMO handle this?

blocks.zh: 要求 w 說「製造商自行建立接受標準」，但 CDMO 認為客戶的跌落測試標準過於寬鬆。CDMO 在技術轉移協議中應如何記錄此分歧？
blocks.en: Requirement w says "the manufacturer establishes its own acceptance criteria", but the CDMO considers the customer's drop test criteria too lenient. How should the CDMO record this disagreement in the technology transfer agreement?

blocks.zh: 23 項設計要求的分類解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the 23 Design Requirements by Category

blocks.zh: 5.5 節的 23 項要求（a-w）可分為五大類：
blocks.en: The 23 requirements (a-w) in Section 5.5 can be divided into five categories:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 雙軌風險管理強制要求：ISO 14971（性能風險）+ IEC 62366（可用性風險）均為 Section 5.3 強制要求，缺一不可；CDMO 技術轉移應要求客戶提供 Risk Management File + Usability Engineering File
blocks.en: Dual-track risk management is mandatory: ISO 14971 (performance risk) and IEC 62366 (usability risk) are both mandatory under Section 5.3, and neither can be omitted; in technology transfer, the CDMO should ask the customer for the Risk Management File and the Usability Engineering File

blocks.zh: 量測不確定度影響合規判定：ISO 14253-1 的保守判定原則要求 CDMO 設定比客戶 Release Criteria 更嚴格的 Internal Acceptance Criteria，以留下測量誤差緩衝
blocks.en: Measurement uncertainty affects compliance decisions: the conservative decision principle of ISO 14253-1 requires the CDMO to set Internal Acceptance Criteria tighter than the customer's Release Criteria, to leave a buffer for measurement error

blocks.zh: 23 項設計要求的優先順序：對 CDMO 最直接相關的是 a-d（劑量可視性）、u（E&L 相容性）、v（ISO 10993-1 生物評估）和 w（製造商自定 AC 的義務）
blocks.en: Priorities among the 23 design requirements: the most directly relevant to a CDMO are a-d (dose visibility), u (E&L compatibility), v (ISO 10993-1 biological evaluation) and w (the manufacturer's obligation to define its own AC)

blocks.zh: 系統整合要求（l, m, n, o）：確認 NIS 設計已針對特定針頭、容器、電子元件進行過整體系統測試，這是 Type A 被廢除後的核心精神
blocks.en: System integration requirements (l, m, n, o): confirm that the NIS design has been tested as an overall system for the specific needle, container and electronic components; this is the core spirit that remains after Type A was withdrawn
